response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with genuine geospatial domain exposure (founder of an open-source GIS platform) and past systems-level programming in D (async I/O, fibers, low-latency services) that shows distributed-systems aptitude. However, his core technical trajectory over the last decade has been web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js, JavaScript), and his C/C++ experience is over 10 years old with no Rust experience at all — a significant gap against the role's primary technical requirement. He could potentially ramp up, but the current skill match to 'modern C++ or Rust' is weak.
strengths: Founder of an open-source geospatial/GIS platform (GISCollective), demonstrating real domain relevance
Prior systems-level programming in D involving async I/O, fibers, caching, and high-performance real-time services
Broad, adaptable engineering background across many stacks with strong learning agility and craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD)
concerns: No recent hands-on modern C++ experience (last significant C/C++ work was ~2014-2015) and zero Rust experience
Career has trended toward web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js) rather than systems or performance-critical programming
No direct experience with navigation/routing systems or production routing tile pipelines

key_factors.factor: Lack of recent modern C++/Rust experience
Systems-level distributed programming experience (D, async I/O, fault tolerance concepts)
